translations.english: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.
translations.hindi: वानरराज सुग्रीव ने विशाल शरीरधारी राक्षसों को वैसे ही मदेन किया, जैसे प्रलयकालीन पवन, बड़े बड़े पर्वेतों को चूर चूर कर डालता है
